brief:
Far-right Trump supporters targeted pro-Palestine demonstrators gathered outside an event featuring activist Hasan Piker in Portland, Eye on Palestine reported. The confrontation quickly escalated as counter-protesters engaged the demonstrators, forcing them to flee through city streets in a chaotic pursuit that drew attention from passersby and police.

The incident underscores widening divisions between pro-Palestine activists and Trump-aligned groups in the Pacific Northwest city. Piker was holding the event when supporters and opponents of Palestinian causes clashed outside the venue, with tensions boiling over into direct physical confrontation and the street-level chase that followed.
